items.condition: Wrong Si substituent, accidental oxidation, missing atoms, unequal-composition energy ranking, vertical energy mislabeled adiabatic, or duplicate collapsed wavefunctions counted as distinct states invalidates the corresponding claim.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

Absolute energies of different elemental compositions do not rank their electronic states. A spin density or aromaticity descriptor does not by itself prove an oxidation rate or air stability. Optical data for oxidized 2M-prime cannot validate unoxidized 2M excitations.
